scientific_question: Is the original single-development-split full-mechanism failure stable under construct-level nested cross-validation on the already-used train+dev development data, without reading the frozen test labels?

development_data.development_data_reuse_disclosure: The 33-row original dev split was used in v1. V2 is therefore a development-only diagnostic, not an independent confirmation.

nested_cv.assignment: sort construct IDs by SHA256(seed + ':' + construct_id), then assign round-robin folds; inner assignment uses seed + ':inner:' + construct_id
nested_cv.alpha_selection: minimum inner out-of-fold RMSE separately within each outer-training partition and feature set; ties resolved by larger alpha then lexicographic alpha string
nested_cv.outer_prediction: refit on the complete outer-training partition with selected alpha and predict the held-out outer fold
nested_cv.primary_inference: the single primary-seed outer-OOF prediction for each of 131 constructs
nested_cv.sensitivity: two complete independently assigned nested-CV repetitions; report point effects and require favorable sign consistency for a development GO
nested_cv.test_partition_role: excluded from every development record table, fold, feature matrix, fit, prediction and metric

bootstrap.seed_derivation: base seed plus comparison index in reference order intrinsic, local_mfe

paired_permutation.scheme: independently swap candidate/reference prediction pairs within each construct
paired_permutation.seed_derivation: base seed plus comparison index in reference order intrinsic, local_mfe

primary_comparisons.multiplicity: Holm across four tests: two references times two metrics
development_go_requires_all: for both references, primary delta Spearman CI lower bound > 0
for both references, primary delta RMSE CI upper bound < 0
both sensitivity repetitions have favorable point-estimate signs for both references and both metrics
independent raw-source verification passes before any later test protocol is considered
primary_comparisons.otherwise: DEV_NO_GO_TEST_UNTOUCHED; no test predictions, test metrics, transport or generator authorization
